brand_identity.name: Tamara's Silk Handloom
brand_identity.ethos: Timeless elegance woven in gold. A digital atelier for the discerning woman.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Manish Malhotra Inspired - Dark, Opulent, Cinematic, Mysterious.
brand_identity.target_audience: Affluent women (25-55) seeking premium ethnic wear.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, hero text, and product names.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, prices, navigation, and buttons.

mobile_first.navigation: Sticky Bottom Bar (Home, Shop, Wishlist, Contact)
mobile_first.header: Minimal. Logo Centered. Hamburger Left. Search Right.

grid_system.gallery: Snap-scroll horizontal carousel for mobile, Grid for desktop

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-3 hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-500 rounded-none font-serif
buttons.secondary: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black transition-colors duration-500 rounded-none

cards.product: group relative overflow-hidden aspect-[3/4]. Image zoom on hover. Info overlay at bottom gradient.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#333] focus:border-[#D4AF37] rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-white placeholder:text-[#555] outline-none transition-colors

home.hero: Full viewport height (100dvh). Video or Slider. Text: 'Elegance Reborn'. CTA: 'Explore Collection'.
home.featured: Horizontal scroll 'Bento' style grid of top collections.
home.about: Parallax section. 'The Art of Silk'. Image on one side, text on other.
home.social: Instagram Grid. 2x2 on mobile, 4x1 on desktop.

shop.layout: Sticky filter bar below header. Infinite scroll grid.
shop.filters: Drawer (Bottom Sheet). Filter by Color, Fabric, Work.
shop.card_style: Minimal. Image dominates. Name and 'Price on Request' below.

product_detail.gallery: Full screen vertical swipe on mobile. 50/50 split on desktop.
product_detail.actions: Sticky bottom bar: 'Inquire via WhatsApp' (Green button).

contact.direct_actions: Large buttons for 'WhatsApp Us' and 'Call Boutique'.

universal_guidelines: Use 'framer-motion' for all entrance animations (fade-up, stagger).
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px for mobile.
Do NOT use standard alerts. Use 'Sonner' for toasts.
Typography is the UI. Keep lines, borders, and dividers to a minimum.
Always check contrast. Gold on Black can be tricky—ensure readability.
Data Source: Create a 'data.json' file in 'src/data/' populated with mock products using the schema above.
